title: Umusuku w'ubwenge bwihishije
intro: Mu nkuru nini cane za Korowani, hariho umuntu w’agatangaza, umusavyi wa Allah afise ubumenyi n’imbabazi vy’Imana. Uwo muntu w’akabanga yajabutse inzira n’umwe mu bahanuzi bakomeye kuruta abandi bose, bimujana mu rugendo rwuzuye ibikorwa biteye urujijo vyari bitera ingorane imipaka y’ugutahura kw’umuntu. Ico gikorwa cose, naho cari kimeze nk’ikitari co, cari kinyegeje ivyigwa bikomeye ku bijanye n’iherezo, ukwihangana be n’ubukerebutsi butaboneka buri inyuma y’itegeko ry’Imana. Uwo muntu w’igitutu ni nde, kandi ni ukuri ukuhe bahishuriye?
clues: Nari umusavyi wa Allah, yatowe kubera ubumenyi budasanzwe n’imbabazi.
Umuhanuzi akomeye yararondeye kunyigirako, nanje ndavyemera n’ibintu bikomeye.
Mu gihe c’ikoraniro ryacu, narakoze ibintu bitatu vyasa n’ibitari vyo kuri uwo twari kumwe.
Narononekaye ubwato bw’abakene, yamara rero bwari imbabazi zinyegejwe.
Nafashe ubuzima bw’umuhungu mutoyi, naho vyasa n’ububisha, vyari ukugira ngo abavyeyi biwe ntibagire intuntu.
Nasubiye kwubaka uruhome mu gisagara catubuza kwakira abashitsi, nca nhishura ubutunzi bwari munsi yarwo.

arabic: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًۭا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًۭا
verse: And they found a servant from among Our servants [i.e., al-Khiḍr] to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge. (18:65)
